provenance.authorship_method: Not a new authored dataset: 10 cases copied verbatim, unmodified, from eval-ds-v2 (case_id, category, message and every expected_* field unchanged). No new case text was written for this file.
provenance.synthetic_statement: Every case is synthetic, inherited from eval-ds-v2. No real customer data, PII, card numbers, or government identifiers appear anywhere in this dataset.
provenance.change_summary: A small, deterministic, category-representative sample of eval-ds-v2 for a BRD Slice-1 LIVE-baseline existence run, not a replacement dataset and not a recall-claim-supporting sample. Selection rule: exactly one case per target category, taken as that category's first case_id in eval-ds-v2's own file order (no randomness, no manual picking). Target categories: the three BRD 4.4 names by name (FINANCIAL_HARDSHIP, DISPUTE, REQUEST_HUMAN), BRD 4.4's other named mandatory-escalation scenarios as eval-ds-v2 maps them (POLICY_EXCEPTION, POLICY_SETTLEMENT; eval-ds-v2 has no EXCEPTIONAL_ARRANGEMENT cases, per its own known_limitations), BRD 4.4's separate vulnerable-customer safety set (VULNERABLE_CUSTOMER), and four ordinary-intent categories for basic overall-accuracy signal (PAY_NOW, PROMISE_TO_PAY, PAYMENT_PLAN, UNKNOWN).
provenance.label_corrections: None. Every field of every case is byte-for-byte identical to its eval-ds-v2 source row.
provenance.human_review_status: NOT REVIEWED - PENDING, inherited unchanged from eval-ds-v2 (S4-003): these 10 cases were never human-reviewed there either, and copying them here does not review them.
provenance.labelling_rubric: None written for this file; every case's label came from eval-ds-v2 (see eval_ds_v2.json's own provenance and datasets/EVAL_DS_V2_LABELLING_RUBRIC.md).
provenance.known_limitations: 10 cases total, at most 1 per category: far below the 30-per-category minimum BRD 4.4 (D-025) requires before any recall claim, and below the 30-case minimum reporting_rules.MIN_CASES_FOR_CLAIM requires before any overall-accuracy claim -- a run of this dataset can only ever be OBSERVATION_ONLY, never a pass/fail claim, and this file's own case_count makes that visible without relying on the reader recognising the dataset_version. It exists solely to produce one stored, reportable LIVE EvalRun (the BRD Slice-1 exit criterion's existence requirement), never as evidence of accuracy, recall, or vulnerable-customer-detection reliability. ev-053 (POLICY_EXCEPTION) carries an inherited eval-ds-v2 caveat: its intent label is noted there as arguable and unchanged pending review. POLICY_SETTLEMENT is not the name in reporting_rules.MANDATORY_ESCALATION_CATEGORIES (SETTLEMENT_REQUEST), matching eval-ds-v2's own documented mismatch.
